DOUBLE GOLD FOR CANADA 🇨🇦

Canadian hammer throwers continue to dominate. Camryn Rogers and Ethan Katzberg claim gold at the Diamond League in Poland today.

Rogers wins with a throw of 77.09. Katzberg with a winning throw of 82.92. Leagues of their own.
